file_name: McCarroll's - Kinghorn Motors and Country Motors - Questionnaire.pdf

questions.text: Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with McCarroll’s, Kinghorn Motors and/or Country Motors.
Do you consider Kinghorn Motors and Country Motors are close competitors for the supply of new cars? If so, please provide reasons why.
In the Nowra area and broader Illawarra region, provide an overview of alternative suppliers of new cars?

Identify your strongest dealership competitors and specify the original equipment manufacturer (OEM) brands that these competitors represent. As part of your response, explain what makes them strong competitors to you (e.g. OEM brand, price, range, proximity, service levels).

To what extent do dealerships offering the same OEM brand compete? For example, how closely do you compete with dealerships that have distribution agreements with the same OEM brand(s) as your dealership?

To what extent do dealerships offering different OEM brands compete? For example, how closely does a Ford dealership compete with a Hyundai dealership? Or a Volkswagen dealership and a Isuzu Ute dealership?

For any new car dealerships you operate in the Illawarra region, specify the distances or drive times your customers travel to purchase a new car. If you do not operate any new car dealerships in the Illawarra region, please respond to the above based on other dealerships you operate in surrounding areas, such as the Southern Highlands, the South Coast, Greater Sydney, or elsewhere in New South Wales.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
